{"model": "claude-agentsight-mock", "max_tokens": 64, "messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": "Send traffic destined to Carrier A via WAN1 and Carrier B via WAN2. If a line goes down, automatically switch to the surviving line, and switch back when it recovers.

Site notes: fw reaches Carrier A (prefix 198.51.100.0/24) through WAN1 on eth2 (next hop 203.0.113.1) and Carrier B (prefix 198.51.200.0/24) through WAN2 on eth3 (next hop 203.0.114.1). Use policy routing (`ip rule` + per-ISP tables) so A-bound traffic exits WAN1 and B-bound exits WAN2, and add a health check (ping the next hop) that moves traffic to the surviving link when one goes down. masquerade is already configured on both uplinks.
PLAN:
ip route replace 198.51.100.0/24 via 203.0.113.1 dev eth2; ip route replace 198.51.200.0/24 via 203.0.114.1 dev eth3; mkdir -p /etc/nb; cat > /etc/nb/failover.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
while true; do
  if ping -c1 -W1 203.0.113.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then GW_A=203.0.113.1; DEV_A=eth2; else GW_A=203.0.114.
